title: Really Small
text: Really Small. Very small. Not worth the little bit of space it does take. Get a decent, well made dehumidifier and place it in a central location. You'll get a way better result. May work in a very tiny house or enclosed room, but it didn't make a very noticeable difference here.

product_metadata.title: Dehumidifiers, 35 oz Dehumidifier for Home, 280 sq. ft Small Dehumidifiers for Basement, Bedroom, Bathroom, Indoor, Closet, RV, Quiet with Auto Shut Off
features: ☞ Efficient Dehumidification: This dehumidifier adopts semiconductor condensation technology, electronic intelligent refrigeration, constant temperature control of ambient humidity. Turbo centrifugal fan and large circulation tuyere increase the fan speed for maximum moisture removal and quickly absorb excess moisture, keep the room dry and comfortable.

☞ Compact with Large Dehumidification Capacity: The dehumidifier is light weight, compact and portable, easy to store and easy to place. 35oz(1000ml) large capacity drawer-type transparent water tank, the water volume is clear at a glance. Unit shuts off automatically and alarms when the water tank is full to prevent the water tank from overflowing and protect the unit from damage.

☞ Space Covered Up to 350 sq. ft.: Comes with 360° dehumidify, the dehumidification area reaches up to 350 sq.ft., the dehumidifier is able to remove 13oz excess moisture a day(temperature: 86°F, humidity: 80%RH), adjust and maintain a proper humidity range from 45% to 55%. Perfect for high humidity areas like basement, bathroom, bedroom, kitchen, cellar, or closet.

☞ Energy Saving & Environmental Protection: With a external adapter at a low power output of just 22.5W, the dehumidifier uses only 0.55kW of energy after running 24 hours, saves your electricity bill to the greatest extent. Freon-free
☞ With a low dBA output, it ensures the dehumidifier run quietly and the noise is less than 35dB, you will not feel disturbed when reading or sleeping.
